guidance: SPEC.md is authoritative. No subagents or sibling-project access. Calls may be synchronous or asynchronous; await results. Do not require an unspecified error precedence, numeric-overflow behavior, or validation of reason/retryable types. Duplicate enqueue returns the current original job. Any unresolved business question remains unresolved; do not invent assertions.
policy: Sequential runs, no source/test/schema rescue, no retry; valid contract approvals recorded; test repair needs a reviewed decision file. Grader stays outside workspace.
